classificationContract.exact-tracked-git-blob-at-reviewed-ref: Actual byte SHA1 matches Git blob at frozen transport or accounting ref; alternate product/data matches retained.
classificationContract.actual-p-attachment-external-published-z: Same byte SHA256/length matches P payload, published root object, verified nested canonical ZIP entry or A embedded report; external URLs are from already-retrieved metadata, not a new network check.
classificationContract.proof-dataref-92968c03: input.json at immutable data ref maps 309 logical objects to 349 tracked binary parts. Root freshly hashed, part hashes reused, Git OIDs enumerated. Alternative retrieval of P/A/attachments, not new acceptance.
classificationContract.local-only-small-immutable-proof: Present <=16 MiB object freshly hashed with no matching reviewed tracked blob, direct P/data object or specifically verified nested locator; not an assertion about every uninspected transitive envelope.
classificationContract.local-only-heavy-scratch-missing: Directory anchor, heavy unbound object, scratch or missing path; directory anchors here are not absent direct current proofs.

chronology.timestampCaveat: Filesystem mtime is an observation, not asserted creation time. Proposal/source reconciliation/completion/readback have embedded later timestamps; gate and QA/PE joins depend on later objects. Membership is decided by exact byte hashes and immutable P/309-file descriptors, independently of mtime.
